KL: 0.5*(KL(p1||p2)+KL(p2||p1)); gradients through both distributions; class-sum then valid-block mean; no extra multiplication by batch or class count.

conditional_control_rule: If an R-Drop arm passes, compare to matched alpha0 two-forward CE control before attributing to consistency rather than averaging two dropout supervised losses. Do not automatically spend controls on a negative screen.
